categories.label: Rank+Importance (live pipeline)
categories.measures: The combined rank+importance+type call every message goes through (rank_importance_and_classify, processor.py:185). This is models.ranking_importance.
categories.scoring: Mean of rank-correlation and importance calibration vs gold.

categories.label: Ranking (import path)
categories.measures: Standalone rank prompt used only by the bulk import path (rank_memory, import_common.py:598) — NOT the live pipeline.
categories.scoring: Rank-correlation of predicted vs gold rank (order matters); flat output scores ~0.

categories.label: Importance (import path)
categories.measures: Standalone importance prompt used only by the bulk import path (ask_importance, import_common.py:648) — NOT the live pipeline.
categories.scoring: Average of correlation and calibration (1-MAE) vs gold importance.

categories.label: Contradiction
categories.scoring: Exact YES/NO accuracy over a balanced set.

categories.label: Dedup verdict (live pipeline)
categories.measures: Given a new memory and up to three similar ones, picks ADD / NONE / UPDATE n / DELETE n as a one-line verdict (processor._decide_and_apply_action). Parsed by the strict grammar production runs; an unparseable reply counts as WRONG here because in production it costs a re-ask and then defaults to keeping the memory.
categories.scoring: Accuracy: action AND target must match gold. valid_rate (informational) = share of replies the strict grammar accepted.

categories.label: Dedup verdict (structured, experimental)
categories.measures: Same cases, asked as a schema-constrained JSON object (memory.dedup.structured_output). NOT the production default: this row exists to decide whether it should be. Displayed, not in the composite.
categories.scoring: Accuracy over schema-VALID replies; valid_rate = share of replies that validated. Enable the toggle only when valid_rate clears ~0.98 on the model that serves models.reasoning.

categories.label: Entity extraction
categories.scoring: F1 of extracted entities vs the expected entity set per item.

categories.label: Coding (agentic)
categories.measures: Real multi-step coding tasks in a sandbox.
categories.scoring: Fraction of verification checks passed (executes code, runs pytest).

categories.label: Coding (legacy - ambiguous)
categories.measures: Runs before 2026-08-03 reported code generation AND agentic coding under one task_type, so this column is whichever one happened to be written last.
categories.scoring: NOT comparable to the two rows above, or between models. Re-run to replace it.

categories.label: Tool calling
categories.measures: Picks the right tool with the right arguments.

categories.label: Session review (chunked, multi-call)
categories.measures: The path a session too big for the context window takes: chunk-scoped reflection per part, then merge_chunk_reflections (processor.py:553-577). Single-chunk cases never reach it.
categories.scoring: 1.0 when the merged reflection does NOT report work that a later chunk resolved as 'never addressed' — the invented finding that flows to lessons.
